redhorn stonethresher (genshin impact).en: A greatsword in Genshin Impact. Usually drawn wielded by arataki itto, and occasionally drawn wielded by noelle (genshin impact).

alternate language.en: An image that has been hard-translated to another language (usually English) by the artist themselves, or by someone authorized by the artist (the company officially publishing a localization, a translator with the permission of the artist, etc).

gender request.en: A request for the gender of one or more characters (1boy, 1girl, 1other, etc.). Please remove this tag once all the correct genders are tagged.

album cover redraw.en: When an artist redraws an album cover. It could also be a parody.

italian commentary.en: For commentary written in italian text.

check gender.en: When a character's gender has been tagged, but a second opinion is needed.

lace-trimmed legwear.en: Legwear that has lace trim around the top edges.

has cropped revision.en: A post with a revision at the source that has been cropped.

goo engine (medium).en: animated engine developed by Dillon Goo.

bad misskey.io id.en: A post from misskey.io that is no longer available from the source link. Usually this is because the work was deleted by the artist.

bad artstation id.en: Used for when any ArtStation post or picture are no longer publicly available.

hatching.en: When a newborn animal breaks through an egg's eggshell.

color halftone.en: An effect that can be seen when printed media is scanned at very high resolution, causing solid colors to appear as dotted patterns.

argyle necktie.en: A necktie that has argyle pattern.

back bow.en: A bow that is tied around the wearer's backside, typically at the waist or sometime seen with bow chokers.

commentary.en: A post where the artist commentary is understandable by the average English speaker. This can be because it was translated by a Danbooru user into English from another language, the original commentary was already in English commentary, or the commentary consists of symbol-only c…

app filter.en: Filters applied to an image after it was created, using a different application. Typically applied through websites or smartphone apps.

ghosting.en: In television, a ghost is a replica of the transmitted image, offset in position, that is superimposed on top of the main image. It is often caused when a TV signal travels by two different paths to a receiving antenna, with a slight difference in timing.

check vehicle.en: The vehicle(s) for a particular post have been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification.

guillotine.en: A machine used to conduct executions by decapitation originating in France.

tinami sample.en: This tag indicates that an image sourced from Tinami is sampled, and is not the original image.

a certain high school gym uniform.en: The gym uniform worn by students at Kamijou Touma's unnamed high school in Toaru majutsu no index.

bad picasa id.en: Used for any post of Picasa that is no longer publicly available there. Picasa Web Albums has been discontinued on May 1, 2016. As such, any Picasa source should by now be a dead link.

cat ear panties.en: Panties with cat ears on them. Usually seen with cat lingerie.

bird request.en: A post having one or more birds, but missing the tags for the specific kinds of birds.

ink (medium).en: A medium that consists of ink which has been applied to a surface, typically paper. The ink can be applied using different tools, such as a nib pen (medium), ballpoint pen (medium), millipen (medium), marker (medium), or calligraphy brush (medium), or through the print (medium).

taiyou iwaku moe yo chaos.en: 太陽曰く燃えよカオス

cinema 4d (medium).en: An image created by Cinema 4D app. If that app appears in a picture, use Cinema 4D.

translation request.en: Any non-English text (usually Japanese, Chinese, or Korean) within an image that needs a translation into English. Audible speech that is not in English and does not have hardcoded English subtitles in the video may use this tag.

has adversarial noise revision.en: For when the revision at the source has been altered with an adversarial noise software.

lofter sample.en: This tag indicates that an image sourced from Lofter is not the highest resolution one available. The "bookmarklet": should be used to avoid samples being uploaded.

nicoseiga sample.en: An image sourced from nicoseiga that is sampled, and is not the original image.

bad booth id.en: Used for any post from Booth that is no longer publicly available there, because the work was either deleted or made private.

henohenomoheji.en: A popular doodle of a face that consists of Japanese hiragana characters as shown below. Normally the "frame" of the face consists of a large "ji", though this is sometimes omitted and cannot be normally typed.

second-party edit.en: Like third-party edit, except the one doing the editing is a second-party to the work (such as its commission) rather than a third-party. If the commissioner is also an artist themselves, the distinction between this and artist collaboration may become blurry.

bad instagram id.en: Bad image source link from Instagram.

sankaku sample.en: An image sample from sankaku complex.

bad inkbunny id.en: Posts that are no longer publicly available at the source on inkbunny.net.

heart hair bun.en: Any number of hair buns shaped to resemble a heart.

bad daum id.en: Used for when any Daum image is no longer publicly available.

bad behance id.en: Posts that are no longer publicly available at the source on Behance, an art site by Adobe.

esperanto commentary.en: For commentary written in esperanto text.

werewolf.en: Humans with the ability to shift shape into wolves or anthropomorphic wolf-like creatures, particularly when the moon is full.

stable diffusion.en: An artificial intelligence that creates AI-generated images from text-based prompts.

resolution mismatch.en: When the image resolution on Danbooru differs from the image resolution at the source. The following two tags can be used with this tag. source smaller: One or both dimensions must be larger than the source.

expression request.en: Use this tag when the appropriate tag for expression is unknown.

3skm (nijisanji).en: A Nijisanji official virtual YouTuber group that debuted in March 2024.

nib pen (medium).en: A work of traditional media drawn with a nib pen, a pen that requires constant dipping in an ink reservoir to function.

animal request.en: A request to identify animals in the post.

nijisanji gamers.en: A former division of Nijisanji virtual YouTubers specifically focused/themed on gaming. The group existed from May 2018 to early 2019 when it was consolidated under a single Nijisanji banner. Its members continue to refer to themselves as the "Ex-Gamers".

unreal (medium).en: Images or animations created using the Unreal Engine, a game engine developed by Epic Games.

charcoal (medium).en: Similar in practice to graphite (medium), charcoal as a medium is distinct in that it produces much darker, fuller blacks. The caveats of this come from it being less hard and more brittle (on average) than its grey cousin.

filipino commentary.en: For commentary written in Filipino text.

looping animation.en: An animated where the start and end blend seamlessly together to create the illusion of a never-ending animation with no beginning or end. Note that an obvious fade between the start and end, or a fade to black/white are not seamless transitions.

medibang paint (medium).en: An image created or edited with MediBang Paint.

avatar generator.en: Images that were not drawn by the original poster, but were rather made using the pre-made assets on image generator sites such as Picrew.

forge.en: A furnace used by blacksmiths and other metalworkers. Used to heat up metal in order to make it softer and thus easier to form into the desired shape. The word may also be used in an expansive way to refer to the artisan's entire workshop.

tatar commentary.en: For commentary written in Tatar text.

english commentary.en: Artist commentary that is originally written in english text. This tag is not to be used for commentary that is translated into English by a Danbooru user.

custom order maid 3d 2.en: Custom Order Maid 3D2 (COM3D2) is a CG adult game developed by KISS and released in February 23, 2018. Successor to Custom Maid 3D 2 (CM3D2).

cloth gag.en: A type of improvised gag made by wrapping a piece of cloth around the gagged person's head, with part of the cloth either in their mouth or covering it.

has downscaled revision.en: For when the post's revision at the source has been downscaled.

bad aspect ratio.en: An image which has been poorly-sized such that one direction is squashed or stretched.

gouache (medium).en: Similar in both theory and practice to watercolor (medium)s, gouache has the distinction of laying opaque pigment on a substrate and using the water as a binder rather than to staining the substrate directly.

concept art.en: Concept art is a form of illustration where the main goal is to convey a visual representation of a design, idea, and/or mood for use in films, video games, animation, or comic books before it is put into the final product.

spanish audio.en: A post with audible speech in Spanish, including lyrics in songs.

machine translated.en: Used on posts which contain some form of machine translation (ex. Excite.co.jp, Google Translate, Babel Fish, Microsoft Translator, DeepL, etc.), whether in the post itself by the artist, or in the form of notes.

book cover redraw.en: A redraw of a cover page, often as a parody.

blender (medium).en: Images or animations created using Blender, a free and open-source 3D software suite.

exif thumbnail surprise.en: JPEG images can include an embedded thumbnail image, along with the camera/software metadata.

bad patreon id.en: Old and broken source link from

paintschainer.en: An auto colorized software using Chainer, a deep learning framework. Developed by Taiyama_(tai2an) aka. Yonetsuji Taizan at Preferred Networks, inc

flipaclip (medium).en: A flipbook styled 2D animation app available for Android and iOS.

bad poipiku id.en: Used for when any POIPIKU post or picture is no longer publicly available.

clothing request.en: Use this tag when the appropriate tag for clothing is unknown.

low bitrate.en: animated equivalent of jpeg artifacts, featuring compression artifacts like macroblocking and unintentional color banding.

slideshow animation.en: An animated post that is simply a series of seperate images displayed in a slideshow format.

tagalog commentary.en: For commentary written in Tagalog text.

finnish commentary.en: For commentary written in Finnish text.

cursor (medium).en: Posts that are showcases for custom cursor sets. A download link will usually be provided in the commentary.

bad source.en: A post whose source doesn't directly link to the image or page where the image is from. This includes redirect links and links to an artist's gallery or profile page.

ai-synthesized speech.en: Posts containing audible speech that was generated through AI voice synthesis.

505th joint fighter wing.en: A squadron from World Witches Series, nicknamed Mirage Witches due to their talent in retreating from battle. Their based on located on the borders of Ostmark, near the Carpathian Mountains.

jumpscare warning.en: A post containing a jumpscare directed at the viewer.

duplicate.en: A post that is the same or inferior to an already existing post. This tag only applies to inferior posts that were uploaded after an already existing identical post.

hungarian commentary.en: For commentary written in hungarian text.

vector trace.en: Images that were traced in a vector graphics program and saved as a raster image.

self-upload.en: An image that was posted on Danbooru by its own creator.

ruffle compatible.en: Flash posts that have been manually confirmed to work with the version of the Ruffle.js emulator that's currently used by Danbooru (you can right-click on any Ruffle player window to see the version number).

bad newgrounds id.en: Old and broken source link from

rebelle (medium).en: Tag for posts made in Escape Motions' Rebelle, a digital art software designed to faux traditional media.

flag request.en: Use this tag if the art contains a flag(s) of countries/organizations that you do not know.

indonesian commentary.en: For commentary written in indonesian text.

bad baidu id.en: Used for when any Baidu Tieba post or picture is no longer publicly available.

ai-assisted.en: An image that was initially AI-generated but then painted over or retouched by an artist. This also includes posts where an artist uses an AI-generated image as a background or reference for a drawing.

swedish commentary.en: For commentary written in Swedish text.

bad furaffinity id.en: Old and broken source link from FurAffinity

missing thumbnail.en: The post's thumbnail image is missing from the server or corrupted.

autodesk 3ds max (medium).en: 3D modeling and animation software from Autodesk.

hard-translated.en: An image that has been third-party edit by a third party to replace the original text (Japanese or otherwise) with a translation into English (or hard-translated (non-english)).

solid color thumbnail.en: An image whose thumbnail is simply a solid color rectangle.

has censored revision.en: For when the post's revision at the source has been censored or has a larger amount of censorship compared to the post on Danbooru.

flat chest.en: A female character with a completely flat chest, that is, no breasts whatsoever. For breasts larger than flat yet smaller than normal, use the small breasts tag.

paid reward.en: Uploading paid rewards is not allowed. See forum #168930 for details.

exif rotation.en: An image that has a rotation specified in its Exif metadata. JPEG files can have a flag that tells the viewer to flip or rotate the image.

thai commentary.en: For commentary written in thai text.

rotoscoping.en: An animated technique in which live action footage is traced to produce exceptionally fluid animation.

mixed media.en: Artwork in which more than one medium or material has been employed, such as a combination of traditional media and digital (computer-based) media.

bmp-to-png conversion.en: Image that was converted from BMP to PNG before uploading.

open in winamp.en: For images that have an embedded music/video track.

extraction.en: An image of a character or group of characters that has been taken from another image and has had all other characters, objects, and backgrounds removed from it.

wide image.en: An image that is at least 1024px wide and that has aspect ratio of at least 4:1 (that is, at least four times wider than it is tall). This is equivalent to the tag search {{width:>=1024 ratio:>=4:1}}.

bad mihuashi id.en: Used for when any Mihuashi post or picture is no longer publicly available.

turkish commentary.en: For commentary written in Turkish text.

self edit.en: An image with this tag has been posted by its own photoshopper.

tagme.en: To be used when you know, or feel like, there are more tags to be added but don't know, or can't remember/find them. Tagme is automatically removed once the target post has reached 30 tags.

music video.en: A video set to audible music (instrumental or audible speech).

twitter banner.en: This tag is used when uploading the banner image from an artist's Twitter page. Use the direct image link as the source, and note that if the artist changes their banner image, the source will no longer be valid and will become a bad id.

italian audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Italian, including lyrics in songs.

bad deviantart id.en: Used for when any Deviantart post or picture are no longer publicly available.

overturned car.en: A car that has been flipped on its side or roof.

adobe illustrator (medium).en: Posts made with Adobe Illustrator. For depictions of the software itself see Adobe Illustrator.

derivative work.en: An image derived in part or in whole from a reference work. This includes images based on reference photo, images with poses copied from another work, and images that are traced or outright plagiarized.

tegaki draw and tweet.en: Tatsuya (maboroshi)'s raster graphics editor. Not to be confused with pipa.jp's tegaki blog.

ugoira.en: Ugoira is a custom animated format used by Pixiv. A Ugoira is a Zip file of images, played back using a custom Javascript player.

metadata pun.en: A pun, joke, or reference made using the metadata of an image. This can include an image's file size, dimensions, a video's length, or any number of meta elements that contribute to the pun.

fixed.en: Tag used for scans that had any crease or scan artifacts digitally removed, making the illusion of a cleaner image.

pinyin commentary.en: Commentary that is written in pinyin text. Same rules for that tag apply to this one.

countdown illustration.en: An illustration meant to count down the number days before a video game releases.

bad bcy id.en: Used for any post from bcy.net Since this site's service ended on July 12, 2023, all posts on site from there are assumed to be bad bcy id.

promotional art.en: Promotional art is art used in the advertisement of a work such as an anime, manga, or doujin.

eyecatch.en: The frames before and after the commercial break in the middle of the show and usually illustrated by the production studio doing the show or official illustrators of the series. Mostly also bears the show's logo.

source smaller.en: When the image at the source is smaller (lower resolution) than the image on Danbooru.

source larger.en: When the image at the source is larger (higher resolution) than the image on Danbooru.

weibo sample.en: This tag indicates that an image sourced from Weibo is sampled, and is not the original image.

albanian commentary.en: For commentary written in Albanian text.

roblox (medium).en: Drawings made in Roblox games, usually Free Draw or Spray Paint.

doukyo's.en: A Hololive semi-official virtual YouTuber unit.

russian commentary.en: For commentary written in russian text.

symbol-only commentary.en: A commentary made entirely of symbols or emojis. Written emoticons such as ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ and ASCII art counts for this tag.

calligraphy brush (medium).en: A tag used when an image has elements created through use of a calligraphy brush. For a calligraphy brush appearing in an image, use calligraphy brush.

bad nicovideo id.en: Used for when any Niconico video is no longer publicly available. For unavailable Nicoseiga post or picture, use Bad Nicoseiga ID instead.

r'lyehian commentary.en: For commentary written in the fictional Lovecraftian language R'lyehian.

lowres.en: A relatively small picture. To be more precise, the post must not exceed 500 in either height or width. Approximately equivalent to {{mpixels:<=0.25}}.

watercolor (medium).en: Traditional media art created using watercolor paints.

bad facebook id.en: Old and broken source link from

reverse translation.en: Situations where English in the image has been translated from English to another language (most often Japanese) in translation notes.

resized.en: An image that has been changed from its original size. When using this tag, use one of the following tags in tandem: downscaled upscaled

cardboard (medium).en: The art is made with cardboard. Possibly a cardboard cutout. photo (medium) will certainly also apply.

sound effect request.en: Sound effect text appears untranslated even though the post may otherwise be translated. Sound effects are often skipped because they can be inferred from context, ambiguous, and are less critical to understanding.

vietnamese commentary.en: For commentary written in Vietnamese text.

colorized.en: Originally monochrome pictures that were colored, often third-party edit.

snow (medium).en: Photos of actual snow sculptures and other artwork created with snow.

czech commentary.en: For commentary written in Czech text.

color banding.en: Color banding is a form of image artefacting found in low bit depth images, where the lack of bits cause colors to be rounded rather than blending smothly together.

weapon request.en: Works like tagme, except you need someone to identify the weapon used in a post.

video crop.en: Images sourced from video released by an artist. Such examples of source material include speedpaint or process-steps videos released by an artist or a captured video from a live stream.

character request.en: A request to identify a character in the post.

painting (medium).en: A painting made with acrylic paint (medium), gouache (medium), oil painting (medium), watercolor (medium), or any other kind of traditional media painting medium.

pen (medium).en: Art created with a pen, which deposits ink (medium) onto a surface, typically paper. Resulting lines are thin, with sharp edges. Most pens make lines of constant width, with multiple pens being used to create different line widths.

food art (medium).en: Photos of real food art, including latte art (medium) and kyaraben (medium).

meme request.en: Use if unable to identify meme.

second-party source.en: A post that, rather than sourced directly from the artist, is sourced to someone who posted it on the artist's behalf.

x-ray.en: Seeing inside or through a normally opaque barrier, as if by x-ray vision. Examples: skin, bone, armor, metal containers, concrete walls...

off-topic.en: A post that is outside of the scope of Danbooru and in general is against the rules.

third-party watermark.en: When an image is watermarked by a third-party website such as an image gallery, wallpaper site, or an anime or gaming website displaying official art.

arabic audio.en: Posts with audible speech in Arabic, including lyrics in songs.

romaji commentary.en: For commentary written in romaji text; its usage follows the same applicability rules, so add commentary request when needed.

artist request.en: A request for the artist of a post.

ko-fi commission.en: A tag for posts commissioned via ko-fi .

polystrene (medium).en: Photos of sculptures and other artwork made using polystrene.

alpha transparency.en: An image that contains semi-transparent areas that aren't part of the background.

poorly translated.en: Posts illustrating fansubs or hard-translated images with bad translations that do not match what are being said.

nude filter.en: An image that has been third-party edit to remove a character's clothes, or to make them nude.

partial commentary.en: A case where the artist's commentary is partially translated (usually the artwork's title).

flared muzzle.en: When the muzzle of a firearm is flared and forms a conical shape.

emofuri.en: Animations created with the E-Mote Free Movie Maker software.

language request.en: A request to tag specifically what language a text in an image belongs to. When the language is tagged, please remove language request.

dated commentary.en: Use this tag when the date a picture was created is written somewhere in the commentary.

redrawn.en: A picture that has been redrawn (often by the same artist).

color issue.en: Scanned images with very obvious color problems.

jav.en: An acronym for Japanese Adult Video.

style request.en: Use this tag when you needed a help to identify a specific style parody.

kid pix (medium).en: An image created or edited with Kid Pix.

garage kit (medium).en: Photos of real garage kits. Unlike model kit (medium)s, garage kits are typically premade static figures in very limited production runs that come unpainted and must be painted by the purchaser. Usually made of resin.

hindi commentary.en: For commentary written in Hindi text.

engrish commentary.en: Artist commentary originally written in engrish text.

rem (re:zero) (cosplay).en: Cosplay of Re:Zero Kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu's Rem (Re:Zero).

bad hentai-foundry id.en: Used for any post from Hentai-Foundry that is no longer publicly available there, because the work was either deleted or made private.

flame painter.en: Art made with Flame Painter tool.

source request.en: No source for the image is known, but is desired by one or more members.

hymmnos commentary.en: For commentary written in Hymmnos text.

binding discoloration.en: When the binding of a book or magazine raises the edge of a page off a flatbed scanner, the reduced luminosity causes a colour shift.

bad twitter id.en: A Twitter post or picture that is no longer publicly available.

pdf available.en: For when an artist has a Portable Document Format (PDF) available at their website. These documents are not uploadable to Danbooru, so add this tag whenever one is found.

crayon (medium).en: Use this tag for images that are drawn and/or colored using crayons.

imageboard desourced.en: From February of 2008 up to Late November of 2016, Danbooru rewrote select imageboard sources to "Image board" on upload, such as those from 4chan, Cynthia and Yande.re. Due to the nature of things, it is unlikely for those automatic changes to be reversed. (forum #122820)

english audio.en: A post with audible speech in English, including lyrics in songs.

cleaned.en: Indicates that a post has been modified compared to its original source by removing objects, text, or its background, to create a cleaner image.

game cg.en: An illustration or animated asset extracted from a video game.

hashtag-only commentary.en: To be used for artist commentary that solely contains hashtag(s).

making-of available.en: To use when the drawing process of the post is available somewhere, whether uploaded on danbooru as a making-of, present in the commentary as a video link (to youtube, for example), or available in some other way somewhere (in which case it should be indicated with a link in the…

hebrew commentary.en: Artist commentary that is written in hebrew text.

video game cover redraw.en: A redraw of a video game cover, often as a parody.

hakurei shrine.en: The primary shrine of Gensokyo in Touhou and the personal residence of Hakurei Reimu.

inactive account.en: For when all of an artist's posts are inaccessible due to the account being suspended, made inactive, or deleted. This is considered to be a subset of bad id.

number-only commentary.en: A post whose commentary contains only numbers.

acrylic paint (medium).en: Works that were done using acrylic paint.

mixed-language audio.en: Posts that have audible speech in more than one language, including lyrics in songs. Tag all of the languages included alongside this tag.

third-party edit.en: An image that has been edited by someone other than the artist (a third party).

corrupted twitter file.en: A Twitter image that has been partially corrupted by Twitter itself. This usually manifests as a row of pixels at the bottom of the image, 8 pixels high, copied from a row of pixels 128 pixels above. Often the result of resizing the original image to 2048 pixels wide or tall.

flash.en: As of March 31, 2021, uploading flash files is no longer possible. See forum #183397 for details.

stop motion animation.en: A style of animated that consists of taking images of a subject in different poses, and replaying the images rapidly to create an appearance of motion. Also known as "Claymation," when done using clay (medium).

paint.net (medium).en: An image created or edited with Paint.NET.

psd available.en: For when an artist has a Photoshop Document (PSD) available at their website. These documents are not uploadable to Danbooru, so add this tag whenever one is found.

bad google+ id.en: Used for any post of Google+ that is no longer publicly available there. Google+ has been discontinued in April 2, 2019. As such, any Google+ source should by now be a dead link.

ballpoint pen (medium).en: Art drawn using a ballpoint pen.

romanian audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Romanian, including lyrics in songs.

archived source.en: A post which uses an archived version of its original source.

webp-to-jpg conversion.en: Image that was converted from webp (typically lossy) to jpg before uploading.

check animal.en: The animal(s) for a particular post have been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification.

anime screenshot.en: A still image of an animated sequence (usually animated GIF or video), extracted from an anime.

hard-translated (non-english).en: An image that has been third-party edit by a third party to replace the original text (Japanese or otherwise) with a translation into any language that isn't English.

check artist.en: The artist(s) for a particular post has been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification. Can be used when the post is retrieved from a source that is not owned by the artist in question (ie. third-party source, certain Twitter accounts, music albums, etc).

fiverr commission.en: A tag for posts commissioned on Fiverr

flash 9.en: Adobe made a change to the Flash player after version 9 that broke many older files. As of now, the 51 posts with this tag have been fixed by flipping a flag in the header, as detailed in topic #15331.

german commentary.en: For commentary written in german text.

self-scan.en: An image with this tag has been posted by its own scanner.

bad dropbox id.en: Old and broken source link from Dropbox.com.

canvas (medium).en: A tag used when an image was painted on a physical canvas. For a canvas appearing in an image, use canvas (object)

colorblind mistake.en: A mistake in the coloring of a post caused by the artist being colorblind.

adoptable.en: An art adoptable is an original character design that is put up for sale or auction by the artist. The purchaser usually receives a higher resolution version of the initial illustration, alongside permission to use the character however they please.

ugoira conversion.en: A Pixiv Ugoira that has been converted to some other animated or video format prior to being uploaded. Ugoira conversions should not be uploaded to Danbooru. Ugoiras have been natively supported by Danbooru since 2014.

collaboration request.en: Used along with artist request when not all artists of an artist collaboration are known.

model kit (medium).en: Photos of works made with real model kits, including custom gunpla, scratch-built resin kits, and other models.

korean commentary.en: Artist commentary that is written in korean text.

animated.en: An animated sequence, whether an animated gif, animated png, flash, ugoira, or video file. Posts should always be tagged one of these more specific tags in addition to animated.

check character.en: The character(s) for a particular post have been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification.

volume warning.en: A post with sound that contains a sudden change in volume or that is very loud to begin with.

arabic commentary.en: For commentary written in arabic text.

thai audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Thai, including lyrics in songs.

ai-generated.en: Uploading fully AI-generated art to Danbooru is against the help:upload rules; see forum #223144.

bib shorts.en: Bib shorts are a type of bike shorts that have an integrated bib (suspenders/braces) to stay up instead of using an elastic waistband.

fanfiction available.en: Denotes a post that was made for or is based on a fan-made written work available online.

bad hoyolab id.en: Bad ID from HoyoLab, Mihoyo's international social network site centered around their games.

reference photo.en: A photo (medium) that has been used as a reference by an artist when creating an art piece. The result of using such references can range from detailed recreations of the photographs to simple copied poses, expressions, or situations.

colored pencil (medium).en: Traditional media art created using colored pencils.

doujinshi.en: The Japanese term for independently-published print works. Comics and art books are common. It can be original or fan art.

game request.en: For when you can't determine which specific game in a series.

paid reward available.en: Indicates that the artist has an alternate version of the post, or materials relating to the post, available as a paid reward. Generally the artist has linked to the reward in the post's commentary.

watercolor pencil (medium).en: Written「水彩色鉛筆」, water-soluble pigments packaged as a pencil, delivering the advantages of both colored pencil (medium) and watercolor (medium) in being able to draw fine details and also to blend them with water.

fudepen (medium).en: A work of traditional media drawn with a fudepen. A fudepen (also known as a brush pen) is an ink pen with a brush-like tip that writes like a traditional calligraphy brush.

portuguese audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Portuguese, including lyrics in songs.

production art.en: A catch-all tag for either unfinished works in progress that lead to a final production work, or ancillary reference materials used in the production of a work. This is almost always official art, with the exception of production work of individual doujin animated.

artist collaboration.en: When multiple artists have contributed to a single image.

check source.en: Indicates that the image source needs to be double-checked for verification. May be used if the source is suspected of being a third-party source.

easytoon (medium).en: Easytoon was created at the basis by Takahashi Keijiro from Radium Software in its version 1.0 in 1998

gimp (medium).en: An image created or edited with GIMP (software).

bad superrare id.en: Posts that are no longer publicly available at the source on superrare.com.

key visual.en: A piece of art released by an anime studio as a concept and showcase of how an upcoming anime project will look, often a few months before its airing.

custom maid 3d 2.en: Custom Maid 3D 2 (CM3D2) is a CG adult game developed by KISS and released in July 24, 2015. Successor to Custom Maid 3D (CM3D) and predecessor to Custom Order Maid 3D 2 (COM3D2).

official art.en: Artwork that is made by the official company/artist of a series or character. May have the copyright name, company name, or artist name names emblazoned somewhere on the picture, as well as a copyright notice.

bad privatter id.en: Used for when any Privatter post or picture is no longer publicly available.

novel illustration.en: Official art illustrations that are contained within a novel.

downscaled.en: A form of resized which makes a source image smaller.

merchandise available.en: Artwork designed to be sold as merchandise such as figure, charm (object)s, sticker (medium), acrylic stands, prints and dakimakura (medium)s.

german audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in German, including lyrics in songs.

food request.en: Use this tag if you see a food item in the image but you don't know how to identify it.

french commentary.en: Artist commentary that is written in french text.

live2d.en: A form of animating 2D images using layered segments, allowing for the animation to be generated procedurally rather than requiring frame-by-frame animation. Often employed by virtual youtuber, and used for idle animations in gacha games such as Azur Lane and Fire Emblem Heroes.

bad fandom id.en: Old and broken source link from Fandom (formerly known as Wikia).

noise reduction.en: Waifu2x or similar were utilized to reduce jpeg artifacts and/or general noise.

voice actor request.en: A request for the voice actor.

tall image.en: An image that is at least 1024px tall and that has aspect ratio of less than 1:4 (that is, at least four times taller than it is wide). This is equivalent to the tag search {{height:>=1024 ratio:<=1:4}}.

neckwear request.en: A request to identify specific type of neckwear.

russian audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Russian, including lyrics in songs.

instrument request.en: This tag is used when you don't know the name of a particular musical instrument or the name of a specific instrument model, eg. An electric guitar or a bass guitar.

has artifacted revision.en: For when the post's revision at the source presents more artifacts than the original.

end card.en: An end card is an illustration that commonly appears at the very end of a show and is usually done by a guest artist for the week.

kisekae.en: Kisekae is short for "kisekae ningyou"; a Japanese term meaning "dress-up dolls". This tag is used for images /flashes related to dress-up dolls. For example, a flash with an interactive component where the user adds/removes/places articles of clothing to/from/on a character.

custom maid 3d.en: Custom Maid 3D (CM3D) is a CG adult game developed by KISS and released on January 28, 2011. Predecessor to Custom Maid 3D 2 (CM3D2) and Custom Order Maid 3D 2 (COM3D2).

screenshot.en: A screenshot taken from something other than an anime or a game.

bad reddit id.en: Used for when any Reddit post or picture are no longer publicly available.

bad link.en: A post whose source is a direct link to the image, rather than the page containing the image. For example, a Twitter image link instead of the Twitter post. The Twitter post is preferred because it's not possible to get to the Twitter post from the Twitter image.

translated.en: A post that has been fully translated into English. See translation request for untranslated posts.

incredibly absurdres.en: When absurdres just doesn't cut it for describing an image's dimensions. Sized at least 10,000 pixels in either direction. Approximately equivalent to {{mpixels:>=100}}.

bad xiaohongshu id.en: An image from Xiaohongshu that is no longer publicly avaliable.

print (medium).en: Printing technique that uses a carved block of material, typically wood or linoleum. The artist carves a mirrored relief into the material, creating something akin to a large stamp. The carving is inked and transferred to a medium, typically traditional media.

danish commentary.en: For commentary written in danish text.

bad cgsociety id.en: Used for when any CGSociety post or picture are no longer publicly available.

marker (medium).en: Art done using markers, also known as felt-tip pens, most popularly copic markers「コピック」, but also the more generic "magic markers"「マジック」.

has lossy revision.en: For when the post's revision at the source has been converted to a lossy format (e.g., from png to jpg).

vehicle request.en: Use this tag when you feel the vehicle model would be a useful tag for the image but dont know the model name.

latin commentary.en: For commentary written in Latin text.

millipen (medium).en: Written as「ミリペン」, this common abbreviation of "Millimetre Pen" refers to the instrument also known as a technical pen. It has a hard tip and is known for making solid, consistent lines.

morse code commentary.en: A commentary written in morse code.

commissioner upload.en: A work that was uploaded to Danbooru by the person who commissioned it.

audible internal cumshot.en: An internal ejaculation that can be heard from outside of an individual that is being penetrated. Typically used to add an additional dynamic audio punch to creampies.

open in internet explorer.en: Old browsers such as Internet Explorer 8 and earlier had a unique quirk on how they rendered images when they're highlighted. Artists at the time took advantage of that and added "subliminal" images in their art as a bonus for those that use such browsers.

japanese audio.en: A post with audible speech in Japanese, including lyrics in songs.

disc menu.en: Illustration provided from a interactive menu on a physical release.

fast animated gif.en: Animated GIFs in which the animation speed is too fast for what is going on, ruining the intended effect.

tagalog audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Tagalog, including lyrics in songs.

headwear request.en: A request to identify specific type of hat, helmet or such.

bad cghub id.en: Used for when any CGHub post or picture are no longer publicly available. CGHub would be shut down on the 14th of April, 2014, inspiring several websites to pop up to succeed it spiritually, such as Computer Graphics+/CG+ (later acquired by bad cgsociety id in 2018), bad drawcrow…

bad weibo id.en: Used for any post from Weibo that is no longer publicly available there, because the work was either deleted, made private, or another broken source link.

epilepsy warning.en: Posts with this tag contain animations with flickering lights that may cause epileptic seizures in susceptible people.

pastel (medium).en: Pastel is an art medium in the form of a stick consisting of pure powdered pigment and a binder.

maya (medium).en: Tag for posts made or edited in Autodesk Maya, a 3D editing and animation software.

has watermarked revision.en: For when the post's revision at the source has been watermarked.

headshop.en: A headshop is a type of third-party edit in which a character's head is replaced by the head of another character. Uploading headshops is against the help:upload rules and should not be done.

procreate (medium).en: An image created or edited with the iPad drawing app Procreate.

corrupted metadata.en: An image that has incorrectly set or corrupted EXIF data

cd (source).en: The material was distributed with a commercial music disk whether as a complement or as a frontal illustration.

photoshop (medium).en: An image created or compiled with Adobe Photoshop.

art trade.en: When two artists exchange art with each other based on a request the other gave them. These trades usually have a set meet-up time, and are equal in complexity. This tag is for posts that are drawn as part of said trade.

character counter request.en: For when a number of characters are present in an image (usually more than one), but the gender or number of characters isn't known by the tagger. Replace this tag with the appropriate counter tag for gender (1girl, 1boy, 1other, etc).

bad pinterest id.en: Used for when any Pinterest post or picture are no longer publicly available.

bad bluesky id.en: An image from Bluesky that is no longer accessible.

bad thumbnail.en: A post with a thumbnail that was generated incorrectly due to a bug in Danbooru.

3d printing (medium).en: Photos of figures, sculptures, and other artwork created through 3D printing.

mixed-language commentary.en: Artist's commentary based on the use of multiple languages. For example, when translating / quoting in the original comment.

fake translation.en: Fake translations are not to be posted on Danbooru. Find the original image.

photo (medium).en: An image taken by a camera.

crease.en: A visible fold in a scan image.

french audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in French, including lyrics in songs.

minecraft (medium).en: Artwork made using Minecraft. Typically involves the placement of blocks in a flat arrangement to create pixel art.

polish audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Polish, including lyrics in songs.

absurdres.en: Short for "absurd resolution," very high resolution images. An image with this tag should be at least 3200 pixels wide or 2400 pixels tall. Approximately equivalent to {{mpixels:>=7.7}}.

bad arca.live id.en: An image from Arca.Live that is no longer accessible.

animatic.en: In animation and special effects work, the storyboarding stage may be followed by simplified mock-ups called "animatics" to give a better idea of how a scene will look and feel with motion and timing.

pose request.en: Use this tag when the appropriate tag for pose or posture is unknown.

annotated.en: This tag indicates that translation notes have been used to mark all characters or items in an image. Often used on crossover pictures with characters from multiple series, or pictures containing absolutely everyone.

corrupted file.en: An image that appears corrupted i.e. the full size image is only partially shown, or parts of the image have corrupt pixels. If the original source of the image can be found and reuploaded, then ask for an image replacement in topic #16765.

official wallpaper.en: A wallpaper supplied by official means.

armenian commentary.en: For commentary written in Armenian text.

screenshot redraw.en: When an artist redraws a real screenshot.

has bad revision.en: A post with a revision at the source that is bad, and should not be uploaded.

check weapon.en: The weapon(s) for a particular post have been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification.

lossless-lossy.en: The opposite of lossy-lossless: an image originally in a lossless format, such as PNG, that has been converted to a lossy format, such as JPEG.

koikatsu (medium).en: Posts made in Illusion's 2018 3D eroge. For images of the default characters or the game itself, see Koikatsu.

cyrillic commentary.en: A commentary written in Cyrillic. Not recommended due to redundancy and impossibility of unambiguous definition.

aliasing.en: An image defect that results in jagged or pixelated looking lines.

bad yandere id.en: Used for when any Yandere post or picture are no longer publicly available.

bad pawoo id.en: Used for when any Pawoo post or picture are no longer publicly available.

vietnamese audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Vietnamese, including lyrics in songs.

diorama (medium).en: photo (medium) of dioramas: these are miniature, cut-away scenes.

upside-down commentary.en: When the text in the commentary is written upside down. The presence of upside-down characters doesn't automatically mean upside-down text, the text must be legible for the tag to be applicable.

thumbnail surprise.en: A post which intentionally uses technical tricks to present a full sized image that is deceptively different from its thumbnail.

completion time.en: When the artist has included the total time spent on the artwork. The time can be indicated on the image or in the commentary.

sound.en: A video or Flash file with audible sound. For written onomatopoeia use sound effects instead.

artbook.en: Artwork scanned from an artbook. This may be official art or an original work.

stitched.en: An image made by stitching together multiple separate images posted by an artist.

gacha club (medium).en: For artwork made in the mobile app Gacha Club. Artwork created in this app is typically considered low-quality content, and posting it is generally discouraged.

game model.en: Artwork depicting characters as their in-game models.

portuguese commentary.en: For commentary written in portuguese text.

finnish audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Finnish, including lyrics in songs.

zbrush (medium).en: Tag for posts made or edited in the 3D modeling software ZBrush.

mikumikudance (medium).en: A post created with Miku Miku Dance, whether it's an image or a video.

bad pillowfort id.en: Old and broken source link for Pillowfort

object request.en: When an object that almost certainly has a name cannot be identified, use this tag.

check spoilers.en: Use for when you aren't sure the spoilers tag applies to an image.

check translation.en: The post has been either fully translated or partially translated into English, but a second opinion is needed. This is to ensure the translation is most correct. Any mistakes seen can be corrected.

romanian commentary.en: For commentary written in Romanian text.

paper cutout (medium).en: Also known as papercutting, paper cutout art is the process of using cutouts of paper, oftentimes layered, to create art.

vrchat (medium).en: Posts made using the virtual reality MMO video game, VRChat. For posts related to the game itself, see VRChat.

microsoft paint (medium).en: An image created or edited with MSPaint.

interactive.en: An interactive flash file that's not exactly a flash game.

whiteboard fox (medium).en: An image created or edited with Whiteboard Fox, an online collaborative whiteboard.

twitter sample.en: A image from Twitter that is an image sample, rather than the original image.

catalan commentary.en: For commentary written in Catalan text.

fish request.en: A request to tag specifically what kinds of fish are in the image. When the fish are tagged, please remove fish_request.

pixiv commission.en: A tag for posts commissioned via pixiv Requests.

ukrainian commentary.en: For commentary written in Ukrainian text.

kurdish commentary.en: For commentary written in Kurdish text.

making-of.en: A post that shows various stages in the creative process or an animated timelapse of the drawing process.

aircraft request.en: Use this tag when you feel the specific aircraft model would be a useful tag for the image but still do not know the exact model name.

javanese commentary.en: For commentary written in Javanese text.

flower request.en: A request to tag specifically what kinds of flowers are in the image. When the flowers are tagged, please remove flower request.

swedish audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Swedish, including lyrics in songs.

masking tape (medium).en: Masking tape art is a type of art which makes use of strips of masking tape as an unconventional media tool for artistic production. The type of tape most often used is a patterned tape known as washi tape (和紙テープ).

scan dust.en: Visible dust particles in the image due to improper cleaning of the scanner surface

highres.en: High resolution images. An image with this tag should be at least 1600 pixels wide or 1200 pixels tall. Approximately equivalent to {{mpixels:>=1.9}}.

md5 mismatch.en: A post that doesn't exactly match the post at the source.

papercraft (medium).en: This tag for photos of artwork made from paper. This includes paper child art, paper sculpture, paper cutting, origami, kirigami, and so on.

greek commentary.en: For commentary written in Greek text.

engrish audio.en: Like English audio but the speaker sounds like a Japaniizu goburiin!

scan.en: An image that was scanned from a physical medium such as a poster (medium) or magazine scan.

cosplay request.en: A request to identify one or more cosplays.

parody request.en: When the presence of another parody is not tagged, and you don't know it's origins. Leave a comment about it with whatever details you can spare- The posture, genre of origin, gender(s) of the source parody, anything that precedes or follows the parody depicted.

gracg sample.en: An image sample that is from Gracg.

check flower.en: The flower(s) for a particular post have been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification.

hair ornament request.en: A request to tag specifically what type of hair ornament a character is wearing. When the hair ornament is tagged, please remove hair ornament request.

after effects (medium).en: Posts made or edited using Adobe After Effects. For depictions of the software itself, see Adobe After Effects.

medium request.en: For works where the medium is unknown. {{traditional_media -*_(medium)}} will return more results.

magazine request.en: A request to tag specifically what magazine a scan comes from. When the magazine is tagged, please remove magazine request.

indonesian audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Indonesian, including lyrics in songs.

60+fps.en: An animated with a framerate of atleast 60 fps.

hentai-foundry sample.en: This tag indicates that an image sourced from hentai-foundry is sampled, and is not the original image.

midjourney.en: A generative artificial intelligence program and service created and operated by the self-named independent research organization based in San Francisco.

zerochan sample.en: This tag indicates that an image sourced from Zerochan is not the highest resolution one available. The "bookmarklet": should be used to avoid samples being uploaded.

bad tumblr id.en: Used for when any Tumblr post or picture are no longer publicly available.

krita (medium).en: An image created or edited with Krita.

check copyright.en: The copyright(s) for a particular post have been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification.

fanbox reward.en: A paid reward from Pixiv FANBOX.

cropped.en: An image that is a cropped portion of a larger picture.

serbo-croatian commentary.en: For commentary written in serbo-croatian text.

bad nijie id.en: Used for when any Nijie post or picture are no longer publicly available.

figure available.en: The artwork that a three-dimensional figure is directly based on, most likely in the form of a tachi-e or invisible chair. Or sometimes a promotional art where said figure is held by a character. Helps to indicate which figure in the comments.

spoilers.en: Information that spoils the plot or ending of a work of fiction. As a tag, denotes that the picture contains spoilers.

decensored.en: The 'decensored' tag implies the original image was censored in its original version, but was decensored (drawn over the censorship) by a (for lack of a better word) decensorer.

coupy pencil (medium).en: A brand name kind of colored plastic pencil / plastic-type crayon by Sakura Color Products Corporation.

scots commentary.en: For commentary written in scots text.

nai diffusion.en: An artificial intelligence that creates AI-generated images from text-based prompts.

bad google drive id.en: Old and broken source link from drive.google.com.

check commentary.en: The artist commentary has been either fully or partially translated, but a second opinion is needed. This is to ensure the translation provided is most correct. Any mistakes seen can be corrected.

korean audio.en: A post with audible speech in Korean, including lyrics in songs.

protected link.en: A post whose source is only visible to certain users. This includes posts that are followers-only, login-only, password-protected, or other forms of limiting access by the artist.

reversed.en: When the whole image is reversed, or flipped horizontally, usually a third-party edit of the original image, occasionally an alternate version posted by the artist themselves.

guest art.en: Official art created by a guest artist. Either commissioned by a copyright holder or is gift art to the author of the work by other established artist.

imageboard sample.en: See: e-hentai sample yandere sample sankaku sample konachan sample

spanish commentary.en: Artist commentary that is written in spanish text.

skeb commission.en: A tag for posts commissioned on skeb

chinese commentary.en: Artist commentary that is written in chinese text.

check annotation.en: The post has been annotated, but a second opinion is needed for verification.

bad drawr id.en: Used for any post of drawr, a oekaki site. The site has been discontinued, so all posts on site from there are assumed to be bad drawr id.

chinese audio.en: A post with audible speech in Chinese, including lyrics in songs.

background color dependent.en: Image that is intentionally made to look different over differently colored backgrounds. It can work with transparent background only, or with alpha transparency.

dotpict (medium).en: Simple free-to-use pixel art tool available for Android and iOS

non-repeating animation.en: An animated GIF or PNG that stops at the end of the animation instead of looping forever.

bad id.en: A post that is no longer available from the source link. Usually this is because the work was deleted by the artist.

wax (medium).en: Photos of figures, sculptures, and other artwork made with wax.

fanbox banner.en: A post that was used as a profile banner by the artist on their Fanbox page.

pixel-perfect duplicate.en: A post that is completely identical to its parent, and was either uploaded afterwards or has no source while their parent does, and thus is inferior for Danbooru purposes.

scan artifacts.en: Artifacts made due to poor scan: binding discoloration - The Image gets blurry as the perspective warps to either side due to the page bending bleed through - Visible contour of illustrations from the opposite side of the page color halftone - Visible printing dots, usually in a…

commentary typo.en: When a typo occurs in the artist commentary.

minnan commentary.en: For commentary written in Minnan text.

bad postype id.en: Used for when any Postype post or picture are no longer publicly available.

firealpaca (medium).en: FireAlpaca is a free, Multiplatform art program

dutch commentary.en: For commentary written in Dutch text.

malay commentary.en: For commentary written in Malay text.

coffee (medium).en: Images painted using coffee. This is distinct from {{latte_art_(medium)}}.

textless version.en: An alternate version of an image without text. Generally applies to explicit images that remove the dialogue after the illustration is complete, or to cover that don't have the title or any content rating information.

lossy-lossless.en: An image that has been converted from a lossy image format to a lossless image format. Usually this is a PNG image ({{filetype:png}}) full of JPEG artifacts, because it was originally a JPEG.

bad lofter id.en: Used for when any Lofter post or picture is no longer publicly available.

pixiv banner.en: A post that was used as a profile banner by the artist on their Pixiv page.

amigurumi (medium).en: Photos of real amigurumi work, which are small figures made of crocheted or knit yarn.

check medium.en: The medium for a particular post have been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification.

bad stash id.en: Old and broken source link from Stash

variant set.en: A post that is part of an image set containing a base image and one or more alternate versions. Some part of the base image must remain unchanged (usually the character's pose).

spine (medium).en: 2D skeletal animation software. Primarily intended for use in games and other software, it can also be used for standalone animations.

revision.en: An image that has been altered by the artist to make corrections to it. The changes may be minor (such as a missing mole) or they may be major (correcting for bad proportions, or adding censorship).

non-web source.en: A post whose source is plain text, rather than a link to the website where it originally came from.

bad e-hentai id.en: Used for when any E-hentai post or picture are no longer publicly available.

e-hentai sample.en: An image sample from ehentai. If you come across one of these, mention it in the post replacement thread (topic #16765). Read howto:ehentai to learn how to avoid uploading ehentai samples.

bad photobucket id.en: A post from Photobucket that is no longer publicly available there either due to deletion or being made private.

unconventional media.en: An umbrella tag for anything not that's not digital or traditional media. Things like food art, latte art, kyaraben, physical sculptures, carvings, handmade crafts, and other such things.

rotated.en: Use this tag when a danbooru image is the rotated version of the one at the source.

check food.en: The food for a particular post has been identified, but a second opinion is needed for verification.

bad vkontakte id.en: Bad image source link from VKontakte.

mojibake commentary.en: For commentary written in mojibake text.

animated gif.en: A GIF image which has multiple frames. GIFs with only a single frame should not use this tag. GIFs created from an episode of anime should also be tagged with anime screenshot.

waifu2x.en: Single-Image Super-Resolution for Anime-Style Art using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks.

adversarial noise.en: Images protected using Glaze, Nightshade or other similar programs designed to prevent images from being used as valid training data for AI art generation models.

flipnote studio (medium).en: Software used to create animations on the Nintendo DSi.

source filmmaker (medium).en: Source Filmmaker (often abbreviated as SFM) is a video capture and editing application developed by Valve software for use within the Source game engine.

wood carving (medium).en: Unconventional media artwork made from carving wood.

lego (medium).en: Posts for images of works made out of LEGO pieces, including custom MOC builds and pixel art.

bad baraag id.en: Posts that are no longer publicly available at the source on Baraag.net.

annotation request.en: This tag is a request to label everyone in the image with translation notes. Once this has been done, change it to annotated.

latin audio.en: Tag for posts with audible speech in Latin, including lyrics in songs.

location request.en: Geographic area/place tag is required. See known place: tag group:real world locations & tag group:locations.

clip studio paint (medium).en: An image created or edited with Clip Studio Paint (CSP).

source mismatch.en: A post whose source may have been correct in the past but now (perhaps due to an artist "revision") points to a completely different image (or set of images that does not contain that post).

alt text.en: A post that has additional commentary in the "alt" text of the image.

bad bilibili id.en: Used for when any BiliBili post or picture is no longer publicly available.

partially annotated.en: This tag indicates only some of the characters or items in an image have been annotated.

animated png.en: An animated image in the APNG format, an unofficial, backwards-compatible extension to the PNG format created by the group behind Mozilla/Firefox. Comparable to animated gif files, but with support for 24-bit colour and 8-bit transparency.

recolored.en: Use when an image has been colored differently than its original source.

microsoft powerpoint (medium).en: Tag for images created with Microsoft PowerPoint.

painttool sai (medium).en: An image created or edited with PaintTool SAI.

download link.en: Dubious tag used for when the "source" field supplies a download link instead of a link to the author's page.

nominally apng.en: A PNG file is considered nominally an animated png if it contains APNG chunks but is not actually animated (i.e., the APNG does not contain more than one frame).

graphite (medium).en: Art created using a traditional or mechanical pencil.

bad imgur id.en: Used for any post from Imgur that is no longer publicly available there, because the work was either deleted or made private.

unfinished.en: An incomplete work, including cases such as sketches, lineart, or flat color illustrations posted before the final image, or scrapped works that the artist decided not to complete. Posts that show various steps in the creation process should be tagged with making-of instead.

dog request.en: A request to add one or more tags for dog breeds (like poodle, bulldog, beagle, etc.) that are missing from the post.

gift art.en: When an artist draws an image to give as a gift to someone else.

polish commentary.en: For commentary written in polish text.

pixiv sample.en: A image from Pixiv that is an image sample, rather than the original image.

bad nicoseiga id.en: Used for when any Nicoseiga post or picture are no longer publicly available. Starting October 30th 2024, Nicoseiga has blocked all access from outside of Japan.

oil painting (medium).en: For when the image itself is an oil on canvas painting. Not to be confused with an oil painting in the image.

wallpaper forced.en: A picture which has been forced into a wallpaper standard resolution: 640x480px, 800x600px 1024x768px, 1280x720px, 1600x900px 1920x1080px, etc. Either by resized or cropped. Often results in a bad aspect ratio if it is resized as-is.

bad drawcrowd id.en: Used for when any Drawcrowd post or picture are no longer publicly available. Most often involves a redirect to Has been down since early 2018.
